title: TG Payments
tagline: Creating full onchain txs via telegram mini apps. You create a swap and then execute via the app
description:
I made a the tg mini app payments project and paymaster to work with said payments.

The idea is to add an even simpler way to do intentful txs via tg. But additionally have crosschain features.

Uses react and crosschain oracle intents. All it needs is a validator and an escrow but all that can be done later. The main issue was setting up a reliable payment method, in this instance we now have a function to be edited to accept and payment method directly via a react function.

The paymaster itself is within the domain of account abstraction so it is fully complient.
